description: Look up a single ISRCTN trial by its registry number. Accepts "ISRCTN12345678", "isrctn12345678", or the bare number "12345678". Returns title, condition(s), intervention(s)/phase, derived recruitment status, sponsor, funder, dates, countries, and a note on whether results have been posted.

id.description: The ISRCTN trial number, with or without the "ISRCTN" prefix (e.g. "ISRCTN37167117" or "37167117").

name: isrctn_trial
